patterns: APPSC asks one-fact current-affairs items right after each mission: Ch-3 lander/rover names (Vikram/Pragyan), element found (sulphur), Aditya-L1 launch date (2 Sep 2023), XPoSat with RRI, SpaDeX = docking.
Options are close-name distractors (Aditya-S1/P1/M1; WPoSat/GPoSat/RPoSat) or near dates (2 Aug vs 2 Sep 2023); APPSC 2022 also tested 'Shukrayaan to Saturn' as a false statement.
Other PSCs add rank facts (India 4th to soft-land), payload -> function (APXS elemental composition), launch-vehicle pairs and Mangalyaan first-attempt record.
App MCQs are mostly multi-statement / match items with payload and vehicle detail (SoLEXS, HEL1OS, Chang'e, Psyche, Nuri) - deeper than APPSC's single-fact style but factually sound.
